html:
A footballer born in Abidjan, captain of Ivory Coast and star striker of Chelsea, among the best African players of his generation.

When Ivory Coast qualified for its first World Cup in October 2005, during the civil war, Drogba and his teammates knelt in the dressing room before the television cameras and begged both sides to lay down their arms. In 2007 he took a national team match to Bouake, the rebel capital. Many Ivorians credit the team, the Elephants, with helping hold the country together. He later sat on the truth commission after the 2011 war.
